Title: User views address on Contact Us page
Preconditions: App is running via `streamlit run ui/app.py`
Steps: 1. Launch the app | 2. In the sidebar, select "Contact Us" | 3. Observe the page content
Expected Result: The Contact Us page displays an "Address" subheader followed by the text "ABC park, Pune"

Title: Navigate from Home to Contact Us and verify address end-to-end
Preconditions: App is running and browser is open to the app URL
Steps: 1. Load the app (defaults to "Home" page) | 2. Verify Home page renders with title "Enterprise AI Platform" | 3. Click "Contact Us" in the sidebar radio navigation | 4. Verify the page updates to show "Contact Us" title, intro text, and address
Expected Result: User successfully navigates from Home to Contact Us and the address "ABC park, Pune" is visible without errors or page crash

Title: Rapidly toggle between Home and Contact Us pages
Steps: 1. Select "Contact Us" in sidebar | 2. Immediately select "Home" | 3. Immediately select "Contact Us" again in quick succession
Expected Result: App remains stable, no exceptions are thrown, and the address text renders correctly each time "Contact Us" is selected

Title: Address text matches exact JIRA MT-4 requirement
Steps: 1. Open ui/app.py source | 2. Navigate to Contact Us page in running app | 3. Compare rendered address text against ticket description
Expected Result: Rendered address text exactly matches "ABC park, Pune" with no typos or missing punctuation

Title: Address subheader does not appear on Home page
Steps: 1. Load the app, ensure "Home" is selected in sidebar | 2. Inspect the rendered page content | 3. Search for "Address" subheader or "ABC park, Pune" text
Expected Result: Neither the "Address" subheader nor the "ABC park, Pune" text appears on the Home page, confirming address is scoped only to Contact Us
